These nitrides act as dispersion strengtheners within the weld zone.

The mechanism of grain refinement through ultrasonic assistance can be explained from two aspects: (1) Ultrasonic assistance increases the nucleation rate; (2) ultrasonic induction grain fragmentation.

With the introduction of ultrasonic assistance, the dendritic structure within the weld zone is disrupted by the energy introduced by ultrasound, and this phenomenon is referred to as the “molten pool sound pressure effect”.
